title: OK for home
text: OK for home. We go through coffee makers, using them almost daily. I get used to the one that I have over time and then when I go to buy a new one, can't usually order the same one. I purchased this Mr. Coffee model after reading reviews. Pro: it doesn't have a light/display on the front, it's on the bottom so I don't see the light from the bedroom. Con: the automatic button isn't very buttony. And I have to often push multiple times to get it to turn on. This is a pain. Other than that, it's an OK coffee maker. Not the best one, and probably not the worst one.
